solution.title: macOS Automated Device Enrollment with SSO (Jamf Pro + Intune)

products.name: macOS Automated Device Enrollment with SSO (Jamf Pro + Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Keep Jamf Pro as your Mac MDM and make every company Mac Entra-registered, Intune-compliant, and SSO-enforced. Stand up Jamf ADE + Platform SSO + the Jamf–Intune compliance connector yourself with self-guided, tested steps — for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Jamf-managed Macs that sign in with corporate identity — and are enforced by Conditional Access

You run Jamf Pro for your Macs, and you should keep it — a Mac can only have one MDM. But Jamf-only Macs are invisible to Microsoft Entra: not registered, not compliant, and not gated by the same Conditional Access that protects your Windows estate. This solution closes that gap. Apple Automated Device Enrollment (ADE) enrolls a company Mac into Jamf Pro the moment it powers on — supervised, managed, branded — Platform SSO (deployed by Jamf) ties macOS sign-in to Microsoft Entra ID with a hardware-bound Secure Enclave key, and the Jamf ↔ Intune Device Compliance integration makes each Mac a registered, compliant device that Conditional Access can enforce. Keep Jamf. Add Entra identity. Enforce SSO.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant to wire Jamf to the Microsoft cloud. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a Mac admin can follow from Apple Business Manager, through Jamf PreStage and Platform SSO, all the way to a registered, compliant, SSO-enforced Mac — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell for both the Microsoft Graph and the Jamf Pro API. Implement on your own schedule and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact Apple Business Manager, Jamf Pro, Intune, and Entra navigation in the right order, written for a working admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable Jamf-plus-Microsoft integration engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with ten validation tests and clear pass/fail gates, so you know a Mac enrolled supervised into Jamf, registered SSO, and reported compliant to Intune before you enforce Conditional Access on the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what ADE, Platform SSO, and the Jamf–Intune Device Compliance integration are, why Jamf stays the MDM while Intune/Entra own identity and compliance, the three authentication methods, and which to use (Secure Enclave key).
  • Requirements Guide — every Apple, Jamf, and Intune prerequisite (ABM, Jamf APNs, the ADE instance, PreStage, Company Portal, the SSO profile, the Device Compliance connector, the macOS Conditional Access policy, network endpoints) with how to verify it and how to implement it if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, click-by-click steps across five phases: connect Apple to Jamf, assign devices & define the PreStage, deploy Company Portal + Platform SSO via Jamf, connect Jamf to Intune and create the Conditional Access policy, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Intune/Entra readiness (Graph), single-device validation (Entra-registered + Intune-compliant), a tenant-wide macOS fleet report, Jamf-side readiness via the Jamf Pro API (ADE/token expiry, PreStage, SSO profile), and a one-shot Jamf Platform SSO profile builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices — including the all-important annual token/certificate lifecycle and the Jamf–Intune connector that quietly breaks compliance when it lapses.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Company Macs that Jamf provisions and manages on first boot, authenticate with Microsoft Entra identity via a phishing-resistant Secure Enclave key, and report compliant to Intune so Conditional Access enforces SSO — deployable by a single administrator in a controlled pilot within a day.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • JAMFADE-DeviceReport.ps1 — tenant-wide macOS report (Entra registration + Intune compliance)
    • JAMFADE-Discovery.ps1 — Intune/Entra readiness check for Jamf-managed macOS with enforced SSO
    • JAMFADE-JamfReadiness.ps1 — Jamf Pro (MDM-side) readiness for macOS ADE + Platform SSO
    • JAMFADE-Set-JamfSSOProfile.ps1 — create & scope the macOS Platform SSO profile in Jamf Pro
    • JAMFADE-Validation.ps1 — validate a single Jamf-managed Mac in Entra/Intune

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
